title: urena lobata var. glauca
intro: Urena lobata var. glauca, commonly known as Burdock or Cocklebur, is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Urena lobata var. glauca include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
